doc.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Elwood Buchanan and German beer
summary: Buchanan as teacher and beer-drinking buddy.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: Tell me something about Elwood Buchanan.

You know what? The only thing I ever knew about Buch was that he and I were pretty good beer drinkers. He was a good trumpet teacher and a good – he had a heck of a reputation over in East St. Louis as a good educator.
What kind of beer did you drink?

In those days – you wouldn’t believe this. I don’t know whether we can even say this or not. I don’t know. It’s a weird beer. It was called – what the hell was it called? It was G-r-e-i-s-i-d-i-e-k. Greisidiek. Greisidiek.
German beer, yeah. Of course Budweiser was there. But people had other ways of expressing the name, which you can imagine.
